dslRule:
<!id: gc.fillRectangle-wrong-x-for-width>
<!description: Corrects usage of Rectangle.x where Rectangle.width is intended for rectangle filling, specifically when the width argument is calculated by subtracting an offset from Rectangle.x. This often indicates a bug where the x-coordinate is mistakenly used for width. >
<!severity: ERROR>
org.eclipse.swt.graphics.GC.fillRectangle($arg0, $arg1, $rectangle.x - $offset, $arg3)
:: instanceof($rectangle, "org.eclipse.swt.graphics.Rectangle")
=> org.eclipse.swt.graphics.GC.fillRectangle($arg0, $arg1, $rectangle.width - $offset, $arg3)
;;
summary: Replaces Rectangle.x with Rectangle.width when used as part of a width calculation (subtraction) in GC.fillRectangle.
